title: Vira Textures
description: Vira Textures mostly cyan with gui
body:
Always update for fixes
This resource pack uses and modifies textures from Minecraft © Mojang Studios.
---

## ✨ Features
- 16x and stylized reworks of textures from existing MIT-licensed mods  
- Seamless integration with vanilla Minecraft aesthetics  
- Compatible with other popular texture packs  
- Lightweight and easy to include in modpacks
